scope: Aligns Streamlit member Daily Food Journal UX with accepted Flutter food journal behavior
Adds parent-level expandable/collapsible Hydration section with Water Intake and Other Fluid Intake grouped inside it
Keeps Bowel Movement and Physical Activity as clean expandable/collapsible sections
Changes Meal Section helper text when a saved date is being viewed
Treats default placeholders such as Select as empty and blocks Save Day unless at least one real entry exists
Prevents Full Day Report and saved-day summaries from displaying placeholder values such as Water: Select
Uses Streamlit date_input and time_input controls for date and time capture
excluded: No admin report data-contract change beyond consuming the same cleaned daily journal payload
